$comment: EXP-1654: the committed sample pictures every specimen host paints instead of a placeholder. The core catalog's examples, the kitchen sink and the Exponential app's styleguide specimens (plan-page, results-tab) name pictures nobody serves (`https://example.com/*` in core.catalog.json + kitchen-sink.json, attachment ids like `sg-1` in plan-page.json and stories.json), so a capture lane would photograph a loading ring. A specimen host (web: the kitchen-sink route + the Exponential styleguide specimens; desktop: exponential_ui_screen + the styleguide entries; iOS: the KitchenSink example + ChatSpecimens; Android: the Compose example + the styleguide specimens) resolves a src through `urls` (the exact src) and an attachment id through `attachments` to the file beside this one and paints its bytes (a data: url, a bundled resource), never fetching anything. Only specimen hosts read this file: the SDK renderers, the docs and the product never do. Files: flat PNG mock-ups, a few KB each; a new example picture = one file here + one key.
